summary_en: This phase 1 study tests CMV-specific CD19 CAR T cells given with a CMV-MVA triplex vaccine in people with relapsed or refractory intermediate or high grade B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Patients have leukapheresis, then lymphodepleting chemotherapy on days -10 to -3, CAR T cells by IV on day 0, and the vaccine by IM on days 28 and 56. The study measures safety and feasibility, and the phase is 1.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa células T CAR CD19 específicas para CMV, administradas junto con la vacuna triple CMV-MVA, en personas con linfoma no Hodgkin de células B de grado intermedio o alto que recayó o es refractario. Los pacientes se someten a leucaféresis, luego reciben quimioterapia de linfodepleción entre los días -10 y -3, células CAR T por vía IV el día 0, y la vacuna por vía IM los días 28 y 56. El estudio mide la seguridad y la factibilidad, y la fase es 1.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory intermediate or high-grade B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
Not eligible for, refuses, or previously received autologous stem cell transplant
Karnofsky performance status of 70 or higher and life expectancy of at least 16 weeks
not_for: Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant with active graft versus host disease
Current systemic steroids or chronic immunosuppressant use
Active central nervous system disease, seizure disorder, or central nervous system masses
HIV positive or active viral hepatitis
